standard: IEEE 1800-2023 20.6.1: the default signing is removed but another signing is written (b), simple bit vector types with predefined widths are told apart from others, so `integer unsigned`, `int unsigned` and `shortreal` keep their spelling, packed dimensions keep their declared order, ranges are decimal numbers (g), and `$` stands for the name of an unpacked array (d); a bounded queue keeps its bound (7.10).

The output of each tool is compared with the 20.6.1 spelling, which Celox prints.
